topic: Spotting and reporting phishing: how employees recognise a phishing email or message and what to do in the first minutes (report it, do not click, and what to do if you already clicked)

request.audience: all employees of a mid-size company, mixed technical skill; adults who have seen boring security trainings
request.notes: Corporate L&D, compliance-adjacent but not preachy. Cinema mix: drawn worlds, data pictures, real geography where it helps, meaningful joins, hold-and-transform. Presenter bookends. Keep every statistic sourced and conservative; prefer behaviours over scary numbers.
